title: 10 "One Another" Commands a Godly Man Can't Keep Alone
caption:
Count the "one another" commands in the New Testament and you'll notice something. You can't obey a single one of them by yourself.

You can't confess to one another alone. You can't bear one another's burdens alone. God built your faith to need other men in it.

Pick one of these and do it for a brother this week. Then send him this.
